basic_info.description: Beutifully remodeled home with contemporary updates in an excellent Outer Sunset location just one block from Noriega Street and walking distance to Ocean Beach. Nicely landscaped front garden leads to a large tunnel entry with covered skylight. Gorgeous wood flooring, and newer  contemporary light fixtures. Bright and sunny living room with a fireplace. Formal dining room  leads to remodeled chef's kitchen with quartz counter tops and abundant new cabinetry. New Samsung stainless appliances include a gas range, French door refrigerator with ice maker, and dishwasher,vented over the range microwave oven. Contemporary lighting and large skylight. Bedrooms are with garden outlooks. Updated bathroom with a large skylight, shower with soaking tub, contemporary tile, new vanity and updated lighting. Recently landscaped rear fenced garden with planting beds and low maintenance turf. 2 car car garage with additional storage area,interior access and possible expansion potential.  Freshly painted. Prime Outer Sunset location just blocks to Ocean Beach, and wonderful Noriega Street restaurants and stores, public transportation,close to Goden gate Park.
